permissions.body: Ukuba ukhetha ukuskena ikhowudi QR, KaalKey isebenzisa imvume yekhamera kweso senzo. Ungqinisiso lwesixhobo esikhethwayo kunye nengxelo ye-haptic sebenzisa iimpawu zesixhobo ezifanelekileyo. Ungalawula iimvume kwiisetingi zesixhobo sakho.
permissions.heading: 2. Iimvume kunye nezixhobo zesixhobo

backups.body: Xa usenza ugcino, KaalKey ufihla ugcino usebenzisa igama eliyimfihlo olikhethileyo. Gcina zombini ifayile kunye negama lokugqitha ngasese kwaye uzigcine ngokukhuselekileyo. Nabani na ofumana ifayile kunye negama eligqithisiweyo layo unokukwazi ukubuyisela ii-akhawunti zakho zokuqinisekisa. KaalKey akakwazi ukuphinda alifumane igama eligqithisiweyo eligcinwayo elilityelweyo.
backups.heading: 3. Iikopi

security.body: Gcina isixhobo sakho sihlaziyiwe, sikhusele ngesitshixo sesikrini, kwaye ungabelani OTP ngeemfihlo okanye amagama ayimfihlo. Ukususa i-app, ukucima idatha yayo, okanye ukuphulukana nesixhobo kunokwenza ii-akhawunti ezigcinwe ekuhlaleni zingafumaneki. Gcina i-backup ekhuselekileyo ukuba ufuna ukuchacha.
security.heading: 5. Ukhuseleko kunye nokugcinwa

information.heading: 1. Ulwazi kunye neemfihlo
information.body: KaalKey yi-app yenyani. Iileyibhile zeakhawunti kunye namaxabiso ayimfihlo afunekayo ukwenza iikhowudi zexesha elinye abuthathaka. I-app yenzelwe ukugcina iirekhodi zeakhawunti kwindawo yokugcina ekhuselekileyo yesixhobo. Nabani na onofikelelo kwisixhobo esivuliweyo okanye ugcino oluthunyelwe ngaphandle angakwazi ukufikelela kulwazi olubuthathaka.

sharing.heading: 4. Ukwabelana kunye namaqela esithathu
sharing.body: Ukuqukuqela kogcino kunokusebenzisa iphepha lokwabelana lesixhobo sakho okanye isicholi sefayile ukugcina, ukudlulisela, okanye ukukhetha iifayile. Iinkqubo zabucala zayo nayiphi na i-app yomntu wesithathu okanye inkonzo oyikhethayo ilawulwa ngumboneleli. Esi saziso asenzi ibango elipheleleyo lokuba isixhobo sakho, inkqubo yokusebenza, okanye iinkonzo zokwabelana ezikhethiweyo azize zisebenze idatha.

changes.heading: 6. Utshintsho kunye noqhagamshelwano
changes.body: Esi saziso sihlonyelweyo sinokuphinda sihlaziywe kukhupho losetyenziso lwexesha elizayo. Ngemibuzo yabucala, qhakamshelana nomshicileli we-app usebenzisa ijelo lenkxaso elisemthethweni elinikwe ne-app.

use.body: Ungasebenzisa KaalKey ukuvelisa iikhowudi zokuqinisekisa kwii-akhawunti ogunyaziswe ukufikelela kuzo. Unoxanduva lokuthobela imithetho esebenzayo kunye nemigaqo yeenkonzo ozisebenzisayo iikhowudi zokuqinisekisa.
use.heading: 1. Ukusebenzisa kwakho

protectAccounts.body: Unoxanduva lokukhusela isixhobo sakho, iimfihlo zokunyanisekisa, iindlela zokubuyisela kwakhona, ii-backups ezithunyelwa ngaphandle, kunye namagama ayimfihlo. Musa ukwabelana ngeekhowudi okanye iimfihlo nabantu ongabathembiyo.
protectAccounts.heading: 2. Khusela iiakhawunti zakho

availability.body: Iimpawu zinokutshintsha phakathi kokukhutshwa. Kuya kufuneka ugcine i-app ihlaziywa kwaye uqinisekise ngamaxesha ukuba amalungiselelo akho ogcino kunye nokubuyisela ayasebenza.
availability.heading: 5. Utshintsho kunye nokufumaneka

recovery.body: KaalKey ayinakuqinisekisa ukuba yonke i-akhawunti inokufunyanwa kwakhona, ukuba yonke QR ikhowudi okanye ulungelelwaniso luya kuhambelana, okanye usetyenziso luya kusebenza ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka okanye impazamo. Gcina ezinye iindlela zokubuyisela ezinikezelwa yinkonzo efanelekileyo.
recovery.heading: 3. Akukho siqinisekiso sokubuyisela

advice.heading: 4. Akukho ngcebiso yobungcali
advice.body: I-app iluncedo kwaye ayinikezeli ngengcebiso yezomthetho, yezemali, okanye yokhuseleko kwisehlo-impendulo. Ukuba i-akhawunti iphazamisekile, landela inkonzo echaphazelekayo yokubuyisela kunye nesikhokelo sokhuseleko.

liability.heading: 6. Ubutyala kunye nomthetho osebenzayo
liability.body: Ukuya kutsho kumda ovunyelwe ngumthetho osebenzayo, i-app ibonelelwa ngaphandle kwesiqinisekiso sokungaphazanyiswa okanye ukusebenza ngaphandle kweempazamo. Akukho nto kule migaqo ikhuphela ngaphandle amalungelo okanye izilungiso ezingenako ukukhutshelwa ngaphandle ngokusemthethweni. Nayiphi na eminye imida okanye imigaqo yomthetho olawulayo kufuneka ihlaziywe ligqwetha eliqeqeshiweyo kulawulo lompapashi ngaphambi kokukhululwa.

legal.reviewBothDocuments: Nceda ujonge omabini amaxwebhu phambi kokuba uwasebenzise KaalKey. Zibandakanyiwe kwi-app kwaye ziyafumaneka ngaphandle kweintanethi.
